listing.title: Anatolian Shepherd Dog Urn for Dog Ashes, Personalized Memorial with a Photo on a Ceramic Plaque, Pet’s Name and Quote
listing.description:
Summary:
- Handmade wooden urn for pet ashes, solid and durable, personalized with engraved quote, pet's name and dates of birth and death.
- CUSTOMIZATION: send us details including your pet’s name and dates of birth and death, so we can personalize your urn. You can also provide us with a photo of your pet and we will adjust it and print it on the ceramic plaque. Sentence on the wooden paw can also be changed.
- Urn's volume is 9,5 litres (600 cubic inches), suitable for pets up to 95 kilograms (210 pounds). The outside dimensions are: 21 x 29 x 22 cm (8.3 x 11.4 x 8.7 inches).
- Removable lid and brass handles make the urn convenient to use. Wreath decorations and classic urn style make it timeless.
- The lid is not seal. It has to be glued with any all purpose glue to keep it tight.
- Highly detailed photo on the ceramic tombstone plaque is applied by a sublimation method. It is resistant to fading or scratches.
- All of our items are shipped with courier, so we can be sure that the order reaches you in the shortest possible time!

PERSONALIZED URNS COLLECTION with CERAMIC PLAQUE

When the saddest day comes we know that there is nothing that can ease your pain. We are here to help you to say the last goodbye to your precious dog.
We offer a collection of 200 urns with different dog breeds. If you haven’t found the one you’re looking for, send us a photo of your choice and we will adjust it. Give us your dog's name, date of birth and death and we will engrave them and make your own, personal memorial.
Wooden urn is made of birch, which makes it durable and lasting. The urn has brass handles and wreath shaped decorations. Engraving is applied to birch plywood. Its classic style makes it ageless.
This custom made urn will make your pet feel your love forever.
